claims.statement: Management targets an internal store network expansion rate of 15% annually.
claims.quote: internally we go for this 15% number. We plan our land acquisitions, the building of the real estate, the property, all of that on the basis this type of an internal number.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects gross margins to remain around 15% in the future.
claims.quote: 15% kind of a gross margin and let's say around a 5% kind of a net margin should be the North Star for this business even in the future.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management targets a net margin of around 5% in the future.
claims.quote: and a net margin also, we believe that if we can be around that 5% type of a range, ballpark range, we are quite happy with that.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states same-store growth (SSG) should hover around 7% to 8%.
claims.quote: SSG for the business should hover around current levels, which is hovering between 7%-8%, maybe at that level.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states that the e-commerce business DMart Ready will focus on proving its model in 11 markets.
claims.quote: we do want to make sure that in these 11 cities, we are able to prove our model, which basically means that we are giving the service that we've promised to the customer
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts passes on vendor price changes directly to customers.
facts.quote: we basically just pass through whatever pricing that is given to us from our vendors. So, we basically just ensure that the same is passed on whether it is price decrease or deflation or inflation.

facts.statement: The finance and depreciation costs under AS 116 are recorded below EBITDA.
facts.quote: the finance and the depreciation cost under AS 116 comes below EBITDA, so you can look at PBT as a fair indicator of the impact of lease cost in the P&L.

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts implemented a new wage code starting from December 2025.
facts.quote: There has been a slight impact also of the wage code that we implemented from December 2025 and the March quarter.

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts' non-permanent employee count reflects numbers as of March 31st.
facts.quote: the position that you are seeing in the BRSR report is a position at a point in time, 31st March to be precise.

facts.statement: Management states that online shopping service DMart Ready will continue to be driven separately from the physical store business.
facts.quote: if the question is whether there is a plan to integrate AEL with ASL business, so there is no such plan. Because our belief is that the online shopper and the customer that DMart Ready is catering to has some specific needs
